versos.hebraico: וַיַּֽעַן־יְהוָ֣ה אֶת־אִ֭יּוֹב מנ הסערה וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

controles.web: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind,
controles.kjv: Then the Lord answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
controles.livre: Então o SENHOR respondeu a Jó desde um redemoinho, e disse:

versos.hebraico: מִ֤י זֶ֨ה׀ מַחְשִׁ֖יךְ עֵצָ֥ה בְמִלִּ֗ין בְּֽלִי־דָֽעַת׃

controles.web: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
controles.kjv: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?
controles.livre: Quem é esse que obscurece o conselho com palavras sem conhecimento?

versos.hebraico: אֱזָר־נָ֣א כְגֶ֣בֶר חֲלָצֶ֑יךָ וְ֝אֶשְׁאָלְךָ֗ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!
controles.kjv: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.
controles.livre: Agora cinge teus lombos como homem; e eu te perguntarei, e tu me explicarás.

versos.hebraico: אֵיפֹ֣ה הָ֭יִיתָ בְּיָסְדִי־אָ֑רֶץ הַ֝גֵּ֗ד אִם־יָדַ֥עְתָּ בִינָֽה׃

controles.web: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.
controles.kjv: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.
controles.livre: Onde estavas tu quando eu fundava a terra? Declara- me ,se tens inteligência.

versos.hebraico: מִי־שָׂ֣ם מְ֭מַדֶּיהָ כִּ֣י תֵדָ֑ע א֤וֹ מִֽי־נָטָ֖ה עָלֶ֣יהָ קָּֽו׃

controles.web: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?
controles.kjv: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?
controles.livre: Quem determinou suas medidas, se tu o sabes? Ou quem estendeu cordel sobre ela?

versos.hebraico: עַל־מָ֭ה אֲדָנֶ֣יהָ הָטְבָּ֑עוּ א֥וֹ מִֽי־יָ֝רָ֗ה אֶ֣בֶן פִּנָּתָֽהּ׃

controles.web: Whereupon were its foundations fastened? Or who laid its cornerstone,
controles.kjv: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;
controles.livre: Sobre o que estão fundadas suas bases? Ou quem pôs sua pedra angular,

versos.hebraico: בְּרָן־יַ֭חַד כּ֣וֹכְבֵי בֹ֑קֶר וַ֝יָּרִ֗יעוּ כָּל־בְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
controles.kjv: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
controles.livre: Quando as estrelas do amanhecer cantavam alegremente juntas, e todos os filhos de Deus jubilavam?

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֣סֶךְ בִּדְלָתַ֣יִם יָ֑ם בְּ֝גִיח֗וֹ מֵרֶ֥חֶם יֵצֵֽא׃

controles.web: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
controles.kjv: Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?
controles.livre: Ou quem encerrou o mar com portas, quando transbordou, saindo da madre,

versos.hebraico: בְּשׂוּמִ֣י עָנָ֣ן לְבֻשׁ֑וֹ וַ֝עֲרָפֶ֗ל חֲתֻלָּתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,
controles.kjv: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,
controles.livre: Quando eu pus nuvens por sua vestidura, e a escuridão por sua faixa;

versos.hebraico: וָאֶשְׁבֹּ֣ר עָלָ֣יו חֻקִּ֑י וָֽ֝אָשִׂ֗ים בְּרִ֣יחַ וּדְלָתָֽיִם׃

controles.web: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,
controles.kjv: And brake up for it my decreed place, and set bars and doors,
controles.livre: Quando eu passei sobre ele meu decreto, e lhe pus portas e ferrolhos,

versos.hebraico: וָאֹמַ֗ר עַד־פֹּ֣ה תָ֭בוֹא וְלֹ֣א תֹסִ֑יף וּפֹ֥א־יָ֝שִׁ֗ית בִּגְא֥וֹן גַּלֶּֽיךָ׃

controles.web: and said, ‘Here you may come, but no further. Here your proud waves shall be stayed?’
controles.kjv: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?
controles.livre: E disse: Até aqui virás, e não passarás adiante, e aqui será o limite para a soberba de tuas ondas?

versos.hebraico: הְֽ֭מִיָּמֶיךָ צִוִּ֣יתָ בֹּ֑קֶר ידעתה שחר מְקֹמֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place;
controles.kjv: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;
controles.livre: Desde os teus dias tens dado ordem à madrugada? Ou mostraste tu ao amanhecer o seu lugar,

versos.hebraico: לֶ֭אֱחֹז בְּכַנְפ֣וֹת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְיִנָּעֲר֖וּ רְשָׁים מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

controles.web: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?
controles.kjv: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?
controles.livre: Para que tomasse os confins da terra, e os perversos fossem sacudidos dela?

versos.hebraico: תִּ֭תְהַפֵּךְ כְּחֹ֣מֶר חוֹתָ֑ם וְ֝יִֽתְיַצְּב֗וּ כְּמ֣וֹ לְבֽוּשׁ׃

controles.web: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.
controles.kjv: It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.
controles.livre: E a terra se transforma como barro sob o selo; todas as coisas sobre ela se apresentam como vestidos?

versos.hebraico: וְיִמָּנַ֣ע מֵרְשָׁים אוֹרָ֑ם וּזְר֥וֹעַ רָ֝מָ֗ה תִּשָּׁבֵֽר׃

controles.web: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.
controles.kjv: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.
controles.livre: E dos perversos é desviada sua luz, e o braço erguido é quebrado.

versos.hebraico: הֲ֭בָאתָ עַד־נִבְכֵי־יָ֑ם וּבְחֵ֥קֶר תְּ֝ה֗וֹם הִתְהַלָּֽכְתָּ׃

controles.web: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?
controles.kjv: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?
controles.livre: Por acaso chegaste tu às fontes do mar, ou passeaste no mais profundo abismo?

versos.hebraico: הֲנִגְל֣וּ לְ֭ךָ שַׁעֲרֵי־מָ֑וֶת וְשַׁעֲרֵ֖י צַלְמָ֣וֶת תִּרְאֶֽה׃

controles.web: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?
controles.kjv: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?
controles.livre: Foram reveladas a ti as portas da morte, ou viste as portas da sombra de morte?

versos.hebraico: הִ֭תְבֹּנַנְתָּ עַד־רַחֲבֵי־אָ֑רֶץ הַ֝גֵּ֗ד אִם־יָדַ֥עְתָּ כֻלָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: Have you comprehended the earth in its breadth? Declare, if you know it all.
controles.kjv: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.
controles.livre: Entendeste tu as larguras da terra? Declara, se sabes tudo isto.

versos.hebraico: אֵי־זֶ֣ה הַ֭דֶּרֶךְ יִשְׁכָּן־א֑וֹר וְ֝חֹ֗שֶׁךְ אֵי־זֶ֥ה מְקֹמֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,
controles.kjv: Where is the way where light dwelleth? and as for darkness, where is the place thereof,
controles.livre: Onde está o caminho por onde mora a luz? E quanto às trevas, onde fica o seu lugar?

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י תִ֭קָּחֶנּוּ אֶל־גְּבוּל֑וֹ וְכִֽי־תָ֝בִ֗ין נְתִיב֥וֹת בֵּיתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?
controles.kjv: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?
controles.livre: Para que as tragas a seus limites, e conheças os caminhos de sua casa.

versos.hebraico: יָ֭דַעְתָּ כִּי־אָ֣ז תִּוָּלֵ֑ד וּמִסְפַּ֖ר יָמֶ֣יךָ רַבִּֽים׃

controles.web: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!
controles.kjv: Knowest thou it, because thou wast then born? or because the number of thy days is great?
controles.livre: Certamente tu o sabes, pois já eras nascido, e teus dias são inúmeros!

versos.hebraico: הֲ֭בָאתָ אֶל־אֹצְר֣וֹת שָׁ֑לֶג וְאֹצְר֖וֹת בָּרָ֣ד תִּרְאֶֽה׃

controles.web: Have you entered the treasuries of the snow, or have you seen the treasures of the hail,
controles.kjv: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,
controles.livre: Por acaso entraste tu aos depósitos  da neve, e viste os depósitos do granizo,

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁר־חָשַׂ֥כְתִּי לְעֶת־צָ֑ר לְי֥וֹם קְ֝רָ֗ב וּמִלְחָמָֽה׃

controles.web: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
controles.kjv: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
controles.livre: Que eu retenho até o tempo da angústia, até o dia da batalha e da guerra?

versos.hebraico: אֵי־זֶ֣ה הַ֭דֶּרֶךְ יֵחָ֣לֶק א֑וֹר יָפֵ֖ץ קָדִ֣ים עֲלֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?
controles.kjv: By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?
controles.livre: Onde está o caminho em que a luz  se reparte, e o vento oriental se dispersa sobre a terra?

versos.hebraico: מִֽי־פִלַּ֣ג לַשֶּׁ֣טֶף תְּעָלָ֑ה וְ֝דֶ֗רֶךְ לַחֲזִ֥יז קֹלֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm;
controles.kjv: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;
controles.livre: Quem repartiu um canal às correntezas de águas, e caminho aos relâmpagos dos trovões,

versos.hebraico: לְ֭הַמְטִיר עַל־אֶ֣רֶץ לֹא־אִ֑ישׁ מִ֝דְבָּ֗ר לֹא־אָדָ֥ם בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: To cause it to rain on a land where no man is; on the wilderness, in which there is no man;
controles.kjv: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;
controles.livre: Para chover sobre a terra onde havia ninguém, sobre o deserto, onde não há gente,

versos.hebraico: לְהַשְׂבִּ֣יעַ שֹׁ֭אָה וּמְשֹׁאָ֑ה וּ֝לְהַצְמִ֗יחַ מֹ֣צָא דֶֽשֶׁא׃

controles.web: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?
controles.kjv: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?
controles.livre: Para fartar a terra deserta e desolada, e para fazer crescer aos renovos da erva.

versos.hebraico: הֲיֵשׁ־לַמָּטָ֥ר אָ֑ב א֥וֹ מִי־ה֝וֹלִ֗יד אֶגְלֵי־טָֽל׃

controles.web: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?
controles.kjv: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?
controles.livre: Por acaso a chuva tem pai? Ou quem gera as gotas do orvalho?

versos.hebraico: מִבֶּ֣טֶן מִ֭י יָצָ֣א הַקָּ֑רַח וּכְפֹ֥ר שָׁ֝מַיִם מִ֣י יְלָדֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Out of whose womb came the ice? The gray frost of the sky, who has given birth to it?
controles.kjv: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?
controles.livre: De qual ventre procede o gelo? E quem gera a geada do céu?

versos.hebraico: כָּ֭אֶבֶן מַ֣יִם יִתְחַבָּ֑אוּ וּפְנֵ֥י תְ֝ה֗וֹם יִתְלַכָּֽדוּ׃

controles.web: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.
controles.kjv: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.
controles.livre: As águas se tornam duras como pedra, e a superfície do abismo se congela.

versos.hebraico: הַֽ֭תְקַשֵּׁר מַעֲדַנּ֣וֹת כִּימָ֑ה אֽוֹ־מֹשְׁכ֖וֹת כְּסִ֣יל תְּפַתֵּֽחַ׃

controles.web: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?
controles.kjv: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?
controles.livre: Podes tu atar as cadeias das Plêiades, ou desatar as cordas do Órion?

versos.hebraico: הֲתֹצִ֣יא מַזָּר֣וֹת בְּעִתּ֑וֹ וְ֝עַ֗יִשׁ עַל־בָּנֶ֥יהָ תַנְחֵֽם׃

controles.web: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?
controles.kjv: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?
controles.livre: Podes tu trazer as constelações  a seu tempo, e guiar a Ursa com seus filhos?

versos.hebraico: הֲ֭יָדַעְתָּ חֻקּ֣וֹת שָׁמָ֑יִם אִם־תָּשִׂ֖ים מִשְׁטָר֣וֹ בָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?
controles.kjv: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?
controles.livre: Sabes tu as ordenanças dos céus? Ou podes tu dispor do domínio deles sobre a terra?

versos.hebraico: הֲתָרִ֣ים לָעָ֣ב קוֹלֶ֑ךָ וְֽשִׁפְעַת־מַ֥יִם תְּכַסֶּֽךָּ׃

controles.web: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, That abundance of waters may cover you?
controles.kjv: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?
controles.livre: Ou podes levantar tua voz até às nuvens, para que a abundância das águas te cubra?

versos.hebraico: הַֽתְשַׁלַּ֣ח בְּרָקִ֣ים וְיֵלֵ֑כוּ וְיֹאמְר֖וּ לְךָ֣ הִנֵּֽנוּ׃

controles.web: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are?’
controles.kjv: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are?
controles.livre: Podes tu mandar relâmpagos, para que saiam, e te digam: Eis-nos aqui?

versos.hebraico: מִי־שָׁ֭ת בַּטֻּח֣וֹת חָכְמָ֑ה א֤וֹ מִֽי־נָתַ֖ן לַשֶּׂ֣כְוִי בִינָֽה׃

controles.web: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?
controles.kjv: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?
controles.livre: Quem pôs a sabedoria no íntimo? Ou quem deu entendimento à mente?

versos.hebraico: מִֽי־יְסַפֵּ֣ר שְׁחָקִ֣ים בְּחָכְמָ֑ה וְנִבְלֵ֥י שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם מִ֣י יַשְׁכִּֽיב׃

controles.web: Who can number the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the bottles of the sky,
controles.kjv: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,
controles.livre: Quem pode enumerar as nuvens com sabedoria? E os odres dos céus, quem pode os despejar?

versos.hebraico: בְּצֶ֣קֶת עָ֭פָר לַמּוּצָ֑ק וּרְגָבִ֥ים יְדֻבָּֽקוּ׃

controles.web: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?
controles.kjv: When the dust groweth into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together?
controles.livre: Quando o pó se endurece, e os torrões se apegam uns aos outros?

versos.hebraico: הֲתָצ֣וּד לְלָבִ֣יא טָ֑רֶף וְחַיַּ֖ת כְּפִירִ֣ים תְּמַלֵּֽא׃

controles.web: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
controles.kjv: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,
controles.livre: Caçarás tu a presa para o leão? Ou saciarás a fome dos leões jovens,

versos.hebraico: כִּי־יָשֹׁ֥חוּ בַמְּעוֹנ֑וֹת יֵשְׁב֖וּ בַסֻּכָּ֣ה לְמוֹ־אָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?
controles.kjv: When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?
controles.livre: Quando estão agachados nas covas, ou estão à espreita no matagal?

versos.hebraico: מִ֤י יָכִ֥ין לָעֹרֵ֗ב צֵ֫יד֥וֹ כִּֽי־ילדו אֶל־אֵ֣ל יְשַׁוֵּ֑עוּ יִ֝תְע֗וּ לִבְלִי־אֹֽכֶל׃

controles.web: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
controles.kjv: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.
controles.livre: Quem prepara aos corvos seu alimento, quando seus filhotes clamam a Deus, andando de um lado para o outro por não terem o que comer?
